usage: "adb-axi <command> [subcommand] [args] [flags]"
commands[24]{command,summary}:
  adb-axi,"Devices, the resolved target, its foreground app and recent crashes"
  adb-axi devices,"Every attached device with its AVD name, state, API level and form"
  adb-axi doctor,"Check the host, the adb server and the target for things that break a run"
  adb-axi doctor ui,"Find on-device UiAutomation holders and classify them as live, resident, leaked or wedged"
  adb-axi wait boot,"Wait until the device is online, booted, and able to install and launch apps"
  adb-axi wait app,Wait until an app reaches a state
  adb-axi wait log,Wait until a log line after the window start matches a regex
  adb-axi app current,"The app in the foreground now: package, activity and pid"
  adb-axi app list,"Installed user packages with a count, optionally including system packages"
  adb-axi app info,"One package's facts: installed, version, debuggable, pid, foreground, data size"
  adb-axi app install,"Install an APK, keeping app data, and wait until the new version is live"
  adb-axi app uninstall,Remove a package; a package that is not installed is a no-op
  adb-axi app start,"Start an app, then report what is in the foreground and how it launched"
  adb-axi app stop,Force-stop an app and verify its process is gone
  adb-axi app clear,"Clear the current Android user's app data, verify it is cleared, and report the process stopped. Android also stops the app's running processes for other Android users, leaving their data intact."
  adb-axi app kill,"Kill an app's process the way the system does, keeping its task in recents. An app in front is sent to the background first (HOME), which changes what is on screen, and Android kills the app's other background processes with it."
  adb-axi app restore,"Reopen an app from recents so its saved state is restored. It starts the task's own root activity with no launcher category and no flags, which brings the existing task to the front. An app that is still running is brought forward as it is."
  adb-axi app death,"Kill and restore an app in one call, with before and after evidence. It runs app kill, then app restore, so an app in front is sent to the background first."
  adb-axi logs,"A bounded log dump for one window, with level counts and repeats collapsed"
  adb-axi logs mark,"Record the device clock under a name, to scope later logs and crash reads"
  adb-axi logs crash,"Java crashes, ANRs and native crashes in one window, matched by package name"
  adb-axi data db,"List an app's databases, or run one read-only query on a copy that includes the WAL. The copy is taken file by file while the app runs, so a write made during it can be missed"
  adb-axi shell,Run one command string in the device shell and report its real exit code
  adb-axi update,Upgrade adb-axi to the latest published version

  "--debug","-",Print the underlying adb calls on stderr
